mechanism: Prochlorperazine can potentiate captopril's hypotensive effects through additive vasodilation and may increase orthostatic hypotension risk; captopril may enhance prochlorperazine's anticholinergic effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly, counsel on orthostatic precautions, and assess for enhanced hypotensive symptoms; dose adjustment of either agent may be needed if significant hypotension develops.
